items.title: 3.3 Artificial (insaan ka banaya hua) satellites (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3 with Figs. 3.11 to 3.14 and Example 3.4 (PDF 62-65).

blocks.text: Satellites woh cheezein hain jo Zameen ke gird taqreeban circular raste (orbit) mein ghoomti hain. Rockets unhen orbit mein pohanchate hain aur Zameen ki gravity unhen orbit mein rakhti hai. Neeche urne wale satellites ka acceleration Zameen ke centre (beech ka point) ki taraf 9.8 m s⁻² hota hai. Agar gravity na ho to satellite orbit ki tangent par seedha nikal jaye. Daire mein chalte satellite ka acceleration v²/r hai; Zameen ke gird circular orbit mein yeh centripetal acceleration gravity deti hai:

blocks.alt: Zameen ek circular orbit ke centre par. Ek bara elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) orbit ek taraf daire ko chhoota hai aur doosri taraf door tak jata hai. Ek raasta orbit se oopar ke qareeb nikal kar Zameen se door mur jata hai. Labels: 27,000 km/h circular orbit; 30,000 km/h elliptical orbit; 11 km/s ya 40,000 km/h escape (gravity se nikal jana).
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 62): Satellites ke orbits (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Newton ne 300 saal pehle artificial satellites ki prediction (pehle se bata dena) kar di thi. Upar wali figure un ki mashhoor kitab “Principia Mathematica” se li gayi hai. Is ke mutabiq agar kisi kafi oonchi jagah se koi cheez ek khaas speed se horizontal phainki jaye to woh Zameen ke gird ghoomne lagegi.
blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.text: Yahan v orbital velocity aur R Zameen ka radius (6400 km) hai. Eq. 3.14 se:
Yeh woh kam se kam velocity hai jo satellite ko orbit mein rakhne ke liye zaroori hai; ise critical velocity kehte hain. Ek chakkar ka waqt (period) T:
Kitab period 5060 s likhti hai. Kitab hi ke number se 2 × 3.14 × 6400 ÷ 7.9 = 5088 s banta hai, yani taqreeban 85 min (84.8 min). Mota jawab “taqreeban 84-85 minute” theek hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Satellite ki speed se us ka rasta badalta hai: taqreeban 27,000 km h⁻¹ par circular orbit, us se zyada (taqreeban 30,000 km h⁻¹) par elliptical (ande jaisa lamba gol) orbit, aur 11 km s⁻¹ (40,000 km h⁻¹) ya zyada par satellite Zameen ki gravity se nikal jata hai (escape).
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Lekin agar satellite Zameen ki surface (oopar wala hissa) se R se kahin zyada oonchai h par ho to yeh baat yaad rakhni hogi ke gravity ka acceleration Zameen ke centre se faasle ke square ke ulat (inverse square) kam hota hai (Fig. 3.11).

blocks.alt: Baen taraf radius R wali Zameen; centre se surface tak dohra teer R. Bohat door daen taraf satellite apne orbit (madaar) ki arc (daire ka tukra) par, orbit ke saath teer v. Zameen ki surface se satellite tak dohra teer h, aur Zameen ke neeche h >> R likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.11: Zameen ke radius R se kahin zyada unchai h par satellite (kitab ki Figure 3.11 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Satellite jitna ooncha, us ki zaroori speed utni kam aur ek chakkar ka waqt utna zyada.
